dedupe_keys.name: traffic analysis and prediction in urban areas

description: The completed thesis describes, analyses and applies predictive methods to Lisbon traffic data collected through the city’s monitoring programme. The metadata catalogue identifies inductive-loop observations as used input. This supports an implemented road-demand forecasting study, although the short abstract does not list every model architecture, forecast horizon or error metric. The record therefore identifies the documented model comparison without inventing a public package or a best-performing algorithm. Access to its source observations is restricted in the project catalogue; the thesis metadata alone do not release those measurements. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with restricted document or data access and licence label not stated. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
